text:
On a long shift we read your full message, and the welfare officer looked into it. We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal during travel and the concern that the care offered did not meet the standard you expected from Aurelia Skyways. We regret that this experience left you unsettled, and we appreciate the seriousness of your report.

From the safety review completed by the Companion Animal Travel Desk, the handling of live animals is meant to follow a calm and careful process at every stage. The ground team is instructed to move carriers steadily between services, to avoid crowding, and to keep noise and handling to a minimum. Crews also receive practical guidance on route planning, cabin and hold conditions, and the need to observe the species, temperament, and comfort of each animal. When those safeguards are applied properly, they support a smoother journey and reduce stress for both traveler and animal.

Your account has been noted as part of our routine safety work, and it will be used to reinforce the expectations already in place. Where a carrier is delayed, shifted, or placed without enough attention, we treat that as a welfare matter rather than a simple service issue. We are reviewing the handling steps used in this case and will share the concerns with the relevant team so that any lapse can be addressed through coaching and follow-up checks.

We also want to recognize that companion animals are not cargo to the people who travel with them. They are family members, and our duty is to treat them with steadiness, respect, and care. When service falls short of that duty, it is right that travelers speak up. Your message has helped us examine the practical details that matter most, including how staff communicate, how carriers are transferred, and how comfort is protected throughout the journey.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention and for giving us the chance to respond in full. We remain committed to improving the safety and welfare of every companion animal entrusted to Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
